scene_beats.scene_objective: Ninel tries to establish what is real and whether the ship is telling her the truth.
scene_beats.turn: Argo defines her awakening as a return from failure while the planet is revealed.
assumptions: The reflection anomaly is perceptual or system-generated and remains unresolved.

beats.evidence: Ninel wakes without breathing while a diagnostic countdown continues.
beats.tactic: imitate the biological sign she observes
beats.visual_opportunity: Breath becomes visible only after she chooses it.

beats.evidence: Her reflection appears to continue looking after she turns away.
beats.tactic: test the image before it disappears
beats.visual_opportunity: The monitor and real body briefly disagree.

beats.evidence: Argo welcomes her back, withholds an answer, then calls the prior event a failure as the planet appears.
beats.tactic: force Argo to define her past
beats.visual_opportunity: The world arrives in frame only when the answer makes it dangerous.

directing_plan.concept: Ninel learns each sign of life as if it may be an instruction planted by the room.
directing_plan.point_of_view: Stay with Ninel's incomplete perception; never confirm the reflection anomaly independently.
performance_notes: Treat the first breath as a deliberate experiment, not panic.
Test the monitor without displaying fear to the unseen system.
Ask Argo for facts while listening for what the pause conceals.
visual_strategy: Begin with controlled geometry and very limited spatial information.
Allow the frame to widen only as Ninel gains agency.
Reveal the planet as an answer that enlarges the mystery rather than resolving it.
directing_plan.rhythm: Mechanical countdown, abrupt chamber release, held reflection beat, then a longer conversational pause before the final reveal.
assumptions: The observation slit can be concealed until the ship rotates.

blocking_plan.space: Medical chamber at center, black monitor camera-right, observation slit behind the chamber, exit off camera-left.
blocking_plan.axis: Primary axis runs between Ninel and the monitor, later reoriented between Ninel and the observation slit through a shown turn.
positions: Ninel begins supine inside the chamber, head toward camera-right.
Monitor is within seated reach but not directly facing her.

moves.motivation: gain control of her body and locate the voice
test whether the reflection tracks her
follow the changing light and confront the new world

continuity_rules: Show the body turn that reorients the axis.
Keep Ninel's right hand on the chamber edge through the reflection beat.
Planet light grows from behind her during Argo's pause.
assumptions: The set permits a visible 90-degree body turn without moving furniture.

camera_movement_plan.movement_philosophy: The camera remains more controlled than Ninel and moves only when her understanding expands.
assumptions: A short slider or compact dolly can operate beside the chamber.

moves.movement: Translate straight back from Ninel as the chamber opens.
moves.speed: Nearly imperceptible, beginning on her first voluntary breath.
moves.framing: Maintain Ninel centered while expanding from close-up to medium.
moves.end: Medium view revealing the chamber edge and part of the monitor.
moves.purpose: Convert a sealed mechanical image into the first degree of agency and space.
moves.ai_video_prompt: Slow dolly out. Movement: camera translates straight backward from the chamber. Speed: nearly imperceptible, starting on the first breath. Framing: keep Ninel centered. Start: tight close-up through glass. End: controlled medium shot revealing the chamber edge and monitor.

moves.movement: Arc around Ninel during her turn toward the observation slit.
moves.direction: Camera-left to camera-right around her front quarter.
moves.speed: Slow, synchronized with the ship rotation, ending before Argo's final word.
moves.framing: Hold a medium-close single and let the planet enter behind her shoulder.
moves.start: Ninel in profile with the slit hidden by the set edge.
moves.end: Three-quarter view with the planet behind her.
moves.purpose: Transfer the scene from internal uncertainty to an external world without abandoning her point of view.
moves.ai_video_prompt: Slow arc move. Movement: arc from camera-left to camera-right around Ninel's front quarter. Speed: slow and synchronized with the ship rotation. Framing: maintain a medium-close single. Start: profile with the observation slit hidden. End: three-quarter view as the blue-green planet enters behind her shoulder.

assumptions: The reflection effect is completed in postproduction.

shots.movement: slow dolly out beginning on voluntary breath
shots.subject: Ninel's eye and condensation on glass
shots.action: eye opens; she chooses to breathe after observing the frost
shots.composition: eye slightly below center with diagnostic reflection crossing the glass
shots.dramatic_purpose: present life as a learned action rather than an automatic fact
shots.audio: diagnostic countdown, chamber vibration, first dry inhale
continuity: Frost pattern matches the later wider angle.
Countdown reaches seven on the inhale.

shots.movement: complete the dolly out, then hold static
shots.subject: Ninel seated at the chamber edge with monitor background-right
shots.action: she sits, finds the reflection, turns away, then senses it still watching
shots.composition: controlled central geometry; monitor occupies a dark secondary plane
shots.dramatic_purpose: establish geography and let the anomaly occur inside one credible spatial relationship
shots.audio: chamber seal release, fabric movement, low ship hum
continuity: Right hand remains on chamber edge.
Capture clean plate for monitor effect.

shots.angle: monitor surface at Ninel eye height
shots.subject: black monitor reflection
shots.action: reflection appears to delay its turn, then the monitor clears
shots.composition: reflection occupies the center while real Ninel remains only as edge spill
shots.dramatic_purpose: offer evidence without confirming whether it is objective
shots.audio: ship hum drops slightly; no sting
continuity: Match Ninel's head angle from SH002.
Record clean monitor and reflection passes.

shots.movement: slow arc synchronized with Ninel and ship rotation
shots.subject: Ninel with observation slit emerging behind her
shots.action: she questions Argo, follows the changing light, and faces the planet
shots.composition: begin profile with negative space ahead; end with planet behind her shoulder
shots.dramatic_purpose: turn withheld personal history into an external scale of danger
shots.audio: dialogue, deliberate pause, subtle structural groan during ship rotation
continuity: Show the axis reorientation during the move.
Planet reaches final mark before the word 'failure'.
